definitions.sample: 10 positive and 10 nonpositive baseline C results; SHA256 selection within each stratum; no threshold search
definitions.blinding: Program classifier receives no exit, P/L, or entry-minute/future OHLC. Selection uses outcome strata; not independent human blinding or out-of-sample validation.
definitions.parent_check: Selected D/H fixed. Complete adjacent 1h L after H, later complete 1h LH between L and H, then strict observed break of L after both references known. New selected D starts a new scope. An available newer low not adopted by C does not reset the old scope.
definitions.parent_repair: Observed reclaim above selected H after failure makes parent ownership uncertain, not automatically repaired or rejected.
definitions.trigger_check: Initial structural-known reference is preceding complete 15m high + 0.01. Flag only when reference lowers, original price is below initial line and latest confirmed post-HL 15m peak, initial line was not crossed before entry minute, and no new complete confirmed HL exists after that peak.
definitions.trigger_warning: A lower reference alone is a warning, not a rejection. Initial reference is structural, not proof that all original risk/target checks passed then.
definitions.uncertainty: Missing prefix minutes, post-H hourly outside turns, or post-HL 15m outside turns => insufficient evidence; do not count as screen candidates.
definitions.category: If clear: parent failure, then local failed-rebound reentry, then higher 15m low plus higher selected rebound peak => normal continuation candidate; otherwise parent-support retest probe. No category claims a guaranteed reversal.
definitions.screen: Diagnostic candidate only when evidence is clear and either parent or trigger check flags. No saved trade actually removed.
definitions.invariants: Original entries/exits/risk/fees fixed; P1/C/frozen0.2/live unchanged; no monthly sequential replay; no orders; no parameter changes after reveal.
